summary: Auction process under IBC: reserve price dispute; payment beyond 90-day period under Liquidation Regulations due to pandemic; extension granted despite late payment; sale deed executed before challenge; delay in filing appeal; tribunal dismissed challenges on procedural grounds; extension order upheld despite delay caused by lockdown; no prejudice to financial creditor.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (Liquidation Process) Regulations, 2016 Reg. 33
final_judgment: Final judgment not fully stated in provided text, but appeals concerning auction process and payment deadline likely dismissed based on procedural grounds and pandemic circumstances.
